page0.text:
"Haah, haah, haah, ha...!"
Shinji Matou wanders through the forest, his breathing ragged and bestial.
He was headed in a concrete direction, to be clear, but his mental state is utterly lost.
With no objective, all he can do is run. "Wandering" is the only appropriate word to describe his behavior.

page1.text:
"Shit! Just a little more. I was so close, but they all had to get in my way...!"
He pushes tree branches aside with one arm, splashing through the mud.
Shinji heads for the forest exit, his blood stains marking his trail.
Of course, the shoulder wound Lancer gave him hasn't healed.
He's already lost sensation in his right arm.
His wound is red and inflamed, and his arm won't move, like a necrotized limb.

page2.text:
"Hah... Haah, hah, aah...!"
He trips and stumbles into a tree. It must be difficult running with only one arm.
His right arm hangs like dead weight.
Then, he realizes that a part of his body has become dead weight, and starts to laugh.
"Ha... Haha, ahahahaha."
His laugh turns into a coughing fit.

page3.text:
It hurts.
He feels hot and feverish, perhaps due to the wound.
His hazy mind imagines his arm rotting away. Then, he starts to hallucinate about all the people around him also rotting away.
Not just their arms.
All those other idiots should know their place and be hurt even worse than he is.

page4.text:
"Kh..."
He can't stop laughing.
The thought makes the pain slightly more bearable.
He has a real purpose now.
His first goal is to gather arms.
He'll take arms from everyone, no exceptions.

page5.text:
"...Ha. That's good. Now to decide on the first."
The girl who wouldn't do what he said.
She's the one he likes the most, and he can't stand the thought of her looking prettier than him.
"Just you wait, Tohsaka. I'll make you lower than me."
Shinji mumbles a laugh, then looks up.

page6.text:
"Huh?"
That Servant is standing in front of him. When did he get there?

page7.text:
"You..."
He stares at the Servant.
The golden Servant looks down at Shinji the way one might look at livestock.
"You're injured. It looks bad. That must hurt."
His tone is utterly disinterested.

page8.text:
"...!"
Shinji's face distorts.
He glares at the man in front of him, failing to realize what the Servant's words might have implied.

page9.text:
"'That must hurt'!? Whose fault do you think that is? Lancer did this to me because you're so stupid!
You're not even good as a guard dog! How dare you talk to me that way!"
Shinji rages at the Servant.
"...Hmm."
The golden Servant nods,
unconcerned.

page10.text:
"So Lancer gave you that wound. Then he must have let that Master go."
"Yeah, you got that right. Tohsaka got away because you're scum! I want to throw up just thinking about how that cockroach got me!"
"I see. That's too bad."

page11.text:
"Rrgh! Why are you trying to act all cool for? We need Tohsaka to get the Holy Grail, don't we!? Damn it, you ruined everything! Don't you get that!? What are we gonna do—"
"Settle down. The plan hasn't changed. I can still make a Holy Grail."
The Servant speaks emotionlessly.
Shinji doesn't realize that the Servant's red eyes aren't even looking at him.

page12.text:
"How!? Kotomine said that we can't do anything unless we have a vessel! We need more than that kid's heart. It won't turn into a Holy Grail unless we connect it to quality Magic Circuits!"
Shinji approaches his Servant and berates him for his incompetence.
The golden Servant nods again.

page13.text:
"Then there's no problem.
We still have another Master that can serve as a Holy Grail, right here."
Then, he casually thrusts his arm out.

page14.text:
Squish.
Shinji doesn't realize what the noise was until the very end.

page15.text:
"...Huh?"
His stomach feels strange.
When he looks down, he sees a Servant's arm.
The fist is embedded in his body.
It doesn't hurt, nor is there any blood.
The Servant's arm sinks deep into his stomach, as if its performing some outlandish spiritual surgery.

page16.text:
"You desire the Holy Grail? Then I'll give it to you. It's important, so don't let go of it again."
"Ah... Ah, ah?"
Blood vessels swell.
Wriggle wriggle wriggle wriggle wriggle.
He feels something alien swarming and writhing inside him.
"Geeh...geeh, beh?"
And then, he ceases to be Shinji Matou.

page18.text:
He convulses.
There's just a swollen hunk of meat there now.
It has no clear shape.
It's made up only of naked muscles and blood vessels, sudden growths of meat, and short-lived decaying meat.

page19.text:
"OW, iT HURtS, It hURtS, HUrTS, GROw, GROWInG, hElP, eLp, StOP—"
His mind breaks, unable to withstand the discomfort of something wriggling inside him and the pain of endless growth and decay.
The Servant watches for a while, and then departs as if nothing remarkable happened.

page20.text:
"...So hideous. A powerful mage wouldn't have morphed like this, but I suppose there's no helping it."
Chains extend out.
The Chain of the Heavens appears in midair to bind the infinitely expanding and rotting mass of flesh.

page21.text:
Currently it's teetering between growth and decay, but the Holy Grail should quickly learn how to use its host.
Once that happens, the growth should greatly exceed the decay.
At this rate, his Holy Grail will soon be complete.
